narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in southeastern Pennsylvania during the late afternoon and evening of June 27. Rainfall totals were as high as 1 to 2 inches.
ev: Bristol Road in Bensalem Township became impassable due to flooding around Bensalem Boulevard.
There were multiple water rescues from vehicles in Lower Moreland Township. Widespread roadway flooding occurred in the township.
Minor flooding occurred along Pennypack Creek in Northeast Philadelphia.
lsr: Corrects previous flood report from 2 E Feasterville-Trevose. Off duty NWS employee reports flooding on the intersection of Bristol Rd. and Bensalem Blvd.
Montgomery County Emergency Management reports multiple water rescues in Moreland Twp before 8:30 PM. Time estimated via surrounding reports and Multisensor Precipitation Estimates (MPE) data.
The Pennypack Creek has reached flood stage.
Corrects previous flood report from Bensalem. Trained spotter reports flooding in Bensalem with Neshaminy Creek banks overflowing.
Trained Spotter reports overflowing of Poquessing Creek in Bensalem into public areas. Report received via social media.
